[{"insert":"Functional Pump Conditioning
 
This piece keeps a single kettlebell overhead through most of the round, so the shoulder works while the legs and lungs do too. The run comes first, then the push press, then the carry lands right after it with the arm already tired, and the ring plank closes the round. Ninety seconds of rest between sets means each round should be run at a real pace rather than paced out. Keep the ribs down on the carry so the load stays over the shoulder and not out in front.
"}]
